summary: Mizuho Financial Group furnished a Form 6-K reporting first-quarter fiscal 2026 results under Japanese GAAP, including ordinary income of ¥2,520,855 million, profit attributable to owners of parent of ¥422,909 million, and EPS of ¥173.53. It revised its full-year earnings estimate upward to ¥1,400,000 million and maintained dividends at ¥75 per share interim and ¥150 annual. No special-situation event (M&A, tender, restructuring, or other) is present; the filing is a routine earnings release and outlook update, with no deal terms or structural actions.
